name: Form Weighbridge

business_logic: 1. Load draft record by id (route param) into form state

2. Auto-set Tanggal & Waktu Arrival = waktu saat ini HANYA jika draft baru (arrival_datetime masih kosong); jika draft dilanjutkan (sudah punya nilai), pertahankan nilai arrival_datetime tersimpan, tidak ditimpa

3. Tanggal & Waktu Dispatch SELALU live-ticking dari tanggal+waktu saat ini pada setiap form dibuka (baik draft baru maupun dilanjutkan), sampai Simpan ditekan → nilai final dibekukan tepat saat Simpan diklik
4. Net Weight dihitung reaktif = Gross Weight - Tare Weight setiap kali salah satu berubah, field disabled (tidak bisa diedit manual)
5. Render field dikelompokkan per section: Identitas Weighbridge, Kendaraan & Supir, Asal Muatan, Data Timbangan, Dispatch. Label Gross/Tare/Net Weight menampilkan satuan '(kg)'
6. Render breadcrumb (Home > Production Process Activity > Weighbridge > Form, tappable) dan header dengan hamburger
7. On Simpan: validasi field wajib → jika lengkap: bekukan dispatch_datetime ke waktu saat ini → UPDATE record (semua field, status=saved) → navigasi ke Monitor Weighbridge
8. On Pause: UPDATE record (field form saat ini apa adanya, status=draft_paused, TANPA validasi field wajib) → navigasi ke Monitor Weighbridge
9. On Clear: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi: DELETE record → navigasi ke Monitor; jika dibatalkan: tidak ada perubahan
10. On Back: jika form dirty: tampilkan dialog konfirmasi → jika dikonfirmasi, buang perubahan di memori, navigasi ke Monitor; jika tidak dirty, navigasi langsung
11. On tap breadcrumb segment → navigasi ke route terkait
12. On tap hamburger → buka menu navigasi (Ganti Password, Logout)

data_operations.description: SELECT record by id untuk load form state
UPDATE semua field form + status=saved pada Simpan
UPDATE field form apa adanya + status=draft_paused pada Pause (tanpa validasi)
DELETE record pada Clear yang dikonfirmasi

edge_case_handling.condition: Field wajib belum lengkap saat Simpan
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan error inline per field, record tidak tersimpan
Field form terisi dari draft tersimpan, KECUALI Tanggal & Waktu Dispatch yang tetap live-ticking dari saat form dibuka
Tampilkan dialog konfirmasi wajib sebelum DELETE dieksekusi

business_rules_applied: Record tersimpan langsung, bukan approval workflow
Field wajib bertanda asterisk dengan validasi inline
Tanggal & Waktu Arrival otomatis sekali saat draft baru dibuat
Tanggal & Waktu Dispatch live-ticking otomatis sampai Simpan ditekan
Net Weight dihitung otomatis dari Gross - Tare

unit_test_cases.description: sets arrival_datetime to current time when draft is new (arrival_datetime empty)
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has arrival_datetime = null/empty
unit_test_cases.expect: arrival_datetime set to current timestamp (now) exactly once on mount

unit_test_cases.description: preserves stored arrival_datetime when resuming a paused draft
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has arrival_datetime = '2026-08-18T08:00:00' (already set)
unit_test_cases.expect: arrival_datetime remains '2026-08-18T08:00:00', not overwritten

unit_test_cases.description: dispatch_datetime starts live-ticking from current time on mount for a brand-new draft
unit_test_cases.given: form mounted with a brand-new draft (no prior dispatch_datetime)
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatch_datetime updates continuously to current time (ticking) until Simpan pressed

unit_test_cases.description: dispatch_datetime starts live-ticking from current time on mount for a resumed draft, ignoring the stale stored value
unit_test_cases.given: loaded draft record has dispatch_datetime = '2026-08-17T10:00:00' (old saved value)
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatch_datetime ticking starts from current time (now); stored value is not used as the starting point

unit_test_cases.description: freezes dispatch_datetime to the exact moment Simpan is pressed
unit_test_cases.given: dispatch_datetime ticking is active, Simpan clicked at time T
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatch_datetime stops ticking and is fixed to T

unit_test_cases.description: displays both date and time portions of dispatch_datetime (not time-only)
unit_test_cases.given: dispatch_datetime = '2026-08-18T14:30:00.000Z'
unit_test_cases.expect: dispatchDateDisplay shows the formatted date (e.g. '18 Agustus 2026') and dispatchTimeDisplay shows the formatted time (e.g. '14:30') as two separate disabled fields

unit_test_cases.description: computes net_weight reactively as gross_weight - tare_weight when gross_weight changes
unit_test_cases.given: tare_weight = 1000, gross_weight changes to 5000
unit_test_cases.expect: net_weight recalculated to 4000

unit_test_cases.description: computes net_weight reactively as gross_weight - tare_weight when tare_weight changes
unit_test_cases.given: gross_weight = 5000, tare_weight changes to 1200
unit_test_cases.expect: net_weight recalculated to 3800

unit_test_cases.description: net_weight field remains disabled/non-editable regardless of computed value
unit_test_cases.given: net_weight computed = 4000
unit_test_cases.expect: net_weight field disabled=true; direct user edit attempt has no effect on stored value

unit_test_cases.description: returns validation errors and does not save when required fields are incomplete on Simpan
unit_test_cases.given: required field is empty, Simpan triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: validation fails, inline error returned per field, weighbridgeRepo.update() not called

unit_test_cases.description: saves record with status=saved and frozen dispatch_datetime when all required fields are complete on Simpan
unit_test_cases.given: all required fields filled, Simpan triggered at time T
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.update() called with all form fields, status='saved', dispatch_datetime=T; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge triggered

unit_test_cases.description: updates record with status=draft_paused without validating required fields on Pause
unit_test_cases.given: required field is empty, Pause triggered
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.update() called with current field values as-is, status='draft_paused', no validation errors; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge triggered

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog before deleting on Clear
unit_test_cases.given: Clear button pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: confirmation dialog displayed; weighbridgeRepo.delete() not yet called

unit_test_cases.description: deletes record and navigates to Monitor when Clear is confirmed
unit_test_cases.given: Clear confirmation dialog confirmed
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.delete() called with record id; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge triggered

unit_test_cases.description: does not delete record when Clear confirmation is cancelled
unit_test_cases.given: Clear confirmation dialog cancelled
unit_test_cases.expect: weighbridgeRepo.delete() not called; form state unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: shows confirmation dialog on Back when form is dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty = true, Back pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: confirmation dialog displayed before navigation

unit_test_cases.description: navigates directly on Back when form is not dirty
unit_test_cases.given: form state isDirty = false, Back pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: navigates to Monitor Weighbridge immediately, no dialog shown

unit_test_cases.description: discards in-memory changes and navigates when Back confirmation is confirmed

unit_test_cases.expect: in-memory changes discarded, navigation to Monitor Weighbridge triggered, no update call made

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to related route when a breadcrumb segment is tapped
unit_test_cases.given: breadcrumb segment 'Weighbridge' tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigates to the corresponding Weighbridge route

unit_test_cases.description: opens navigation menu when hamburger icon is tapped
unit_test_cases.given: hamburger icon tapped
unit_test_cases.expect: navigation menu opens showing Ganti Password and Logout options

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: new draft loaded, all required fields filled, gross/tare provided, Simpan pressed
unit_test_cases.expect: record saved with status='saved'; arrival_datetime set to load-time; dispatch_datetime frozen at Simpan-time; net_weight = gross - tare; navigation to Monitor Weighbridge triggered

implementation_notes: Simpan/Pause/Clear bersifat lokal (SQLite); pengiriman ke server terjadi lewat mekanisme sync manual terpisah, di luar scope screen ini
Dispatch live-ticking clock butuh interval timer (mis. setInterval 1 detik) yang di-clear saat unmount atau saat Simpan dibekukan, untuk menghindari memory leak
Checked By dihapus total dari layar ini — kolom checked_by di entity tetap ada di skema tapi tidak lagi dibaca/ditulis dari screen ini
Tanggal Dispatch (field baru) memakai fungsi format tanggal yang sama dengan Tanggal Arrival (formatDateID) — tidak perlu fungsi baru, hanya panggil ulang terhadap dispatch_datetime
Label (kg) ditambahkan sebagai teks statis pada label field Gross/Tare/Net Weight, bukan perubahan tipe data/unit konversi — nilai tetap tersimpan sebagai angka polos di kolom yang sama
